jobs.title: Creator Partnerships Coordinator – Influencer Marketing & TikTok
jobs.description:
About United Exchange Corporation

United Exchange Corporation (UEC) is a consumer packaged goods (CPG) company with a portfolio of food, beauty, and personal care products distributed through major U.S. retail and e-commerce channels.

Our brands and licensed product lines include Jif Ramen, Tapatío Ramen, Choi Ramen, and Nu-Pore Beauty.

We are expanding our in-house digital marketing capabilities and launching a Creator Partnership Program to build relationships with TikTok, Instagram, and YouTube content creators.

We are looking for a motivated, organized, and social-media-savvy **Creator Partnerships Coordinator** to help us identify, recruit, and manage influencers who can introduce our products to new audiences.

Key Responsibilities

**1. Influencer Discovery & Recruitment**

* Research and identify nano-influencers (1,000–10,000 followers) and micro-influencers (10,000–100,000 followers).
* Identify creators specializing in food, ramen, Korean food, lifestyle, beauty, and personal care.
* Reach out to prospective creators through TikTok, Instagram, email, and other channels.
* Build and maintain a database of qualified influencers.
* Evaluate creator engagement, audience demographics, content quality, and brand compatibility.

**2. Creator Partnerships & Campaign Management**

* Coordinate gifted product collaborations, paid sponsorships, affiliate programs, and TikTok Shop partnerships.
* Communicate campaign objectives, product information, content requirements, and deadlines.
* Assist with negotiating creator compensation and deliverables within approved budgets.
* Coordinate influencer agreements and required approvals.
* Maintain ongoing relationships with high-performing creators.

**3. Product Seeding & Content Coordination**

* Coordinate shipment of product samples to approved creators.
* Track product deliveries and creator commitments.
* Follow up to ensure timely content creation and publication.
* Collect links to published TikTok videos, Instagram Reels, and YouTube Shorts.
* Identify high-performing content suitable for additional marketing use, subject to usage permissions.

**4. TikTok Shop & Affiliate Marketing**

* Recruit creators interested in TikTok Shop affiliate opportunities.
* Coordinate with our e-commerce team to promote products through affiliate content.
* Track affiliate commissions, sales conversions, and creator performance.
* Help develop a network of repeat creators and brand ambassadors.

**5. Campaign Tracking & Reporting**

* Maintain creator records and campaign workflows using Monday.com.
* Track outreach, response rates, active collaborations, content publication, and campaign performance.
* Prepare weekly reports showing creator recruitment progress, content output, engagement, and attributed sales.
* Recommend improvements based on creator performance and campaign results.

Qualifications

**Required**

* Strong understanding of TikTok, Instagram Reels, and influencer marketing trends.
* Excellent written communication and interpersonal skills.
* Ability to identify engaging content creators and build professional relationships.
* Strong organizational skills and ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously.
* Comfortable using spreadsheets, CRM systems, and digital marketing tools.
* Interest in food, beauty, lifestyle, or consumer products.

**Preferred**

* 1–3 years of experience in influencer marketing, creator partnerships, social media marketing, or digital marketing.
* Experience working with nano- and micro-influencers.
* Familiarity with TikTok Shop Affiliate, creator marketplaces, or influencer management platforms.
* Experience with Monday.com or similar CRM/project management software.
* Experience with consumer packaged goods, food, beauty, or e-commerce brands.
* Familiarity with Korean food trends and Asian consumer products is a plus.

What Success Looks Like

During the first 90 days, the successful candidate will:

* Build a qualified database of 300–500 potential creators.
* Establish a consistent outreach and follow-up process.
* Recruit an initial network of 30–50 interested creators.
* Coordinate product seeding and initial creator campaigns.
* Implement a centralized creator tracking process using Monday.com.
* Deliver weekly reports on recruitment and campaign performance.

These are initial performance targets and will be refined based on available campaign budgets, creator response rates, and product availability.

Why Join UEC?

This is an opportunity to help build an influencer marketing program from the ground up.

Rather than simply supporting an existing agency, you will play a hands-on role in developing direct relationships with content creators and helping launch consumer brands in the U.S. market.

You will gain experience in influencer marketing, TikTok Shop, affiliate marketing, consumer product launches, and e-commerce.

**To Apply**

Please submit your resume and a brief description of your experience with TikTok, Instagram, influencer outreach, or creator marketing.

Applicants who have previously managed creator collaborations are encouraged to include examples of campaigns or creator partnerships they have supported.

Pay: $55,000.00 - $65,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k)

* Health insurance

* Vision insurance
